transport.edges: Undirected source surface adjacency; symmetric nonnegative conductance; zero across protected or unqualified boundaries.
transport.flux: F_ij=tau*s_ij*(L_j-L_i); sum positive/negative requested RGB mass at every node.
transport.gamutLimiter: At each node/channel bound positive mass by a_i*(1-Q_i), negative mass by a_i*Q_i. Each edge gets the minimum corresponding donor/recipient ratio over all RGB channels. Apply one common scalar to both ends and all RGB channels. No final color clamping. Zero-flux channels impose no cap.
transport.conservation: Every accepted flux is equal and opposite in RGB mass. Thus sum a_i*Q_i is unchanged, regardless of nonzero residual mean.
transport.detailPreservation: Store R from paired complete expressions and leave it unchanged; do not preserve only incoming P grain while dropping target or coverage detail.
transport.scope: Discrete offline algebra only; choice of quadrature, nodal representation, interpolation continuity and source masks remains unqualified.
